Yes, that completes the round-trip I had in mind. Clicking the lit button again took it out of the "Read later" view, cleared the count, and left me with that friendly "You're all caught up" message — which is a nice touch, it tells me I've cleared the pile rather than just staring at a blank space.

The one thing I want to be sure of, since I can't see it from this empty screen: marking it as read should only take it out of the *read-later* pile — the bookmark itself should still be safely there in "All bookmarks." Reading something isn't the same as getting rid of it; I've often finished an article but still want to keep the link around. So as long as that link is still sitting in my full collection after this, just no longer flagged as unread, then yes — this is exactly the round-trip I wanted.
